# libKriging

> C++ library for Kriging / Gaussian process regression, with equivalent
> bindings in Python, R, Octave, MATLAB, and Julia.

libKriging implements ordinary/universal kriging with noise-free, homogeneous
nugget, or known heteroskedastic-noise fits — all unified under a single
`Kriging(..., noise=...)` constructor argument, not separate classes — plus
per-variable input warping (`WarpKriging`, for mixed continuous/categorical/
ordinal inputs) and joint deep-kernel learning (`MLPKriging`). Large designs
are handled either by the Vecchia-approximated log-likelihood objective
(`objective="VLL(m)"`, a plain fit option on `Kriging`/`WarpKriging`) or by
the divide-and-conquer `NestedKriging` class (PoE/gPoE/BCM/rBCM or the
interpolating `NK` aggregation). Source and issue tracker:
https://github.com/libKriging/libKriging.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install.html): pip (`pylibkriging`), CRAN/GitHub (`rlibkriging`), prebuilt Octave/MATLAB archives, and Julia source build instructions.
- [Usage](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/usage.html): the minimal fit → predict → simulate example, shared (modulo syntax) across every binding.

## API reference

- [API overview](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html): per-binding call syntax and the full constructor / fit / predict / simulate function index.
- [Kriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/Kriging.html): the main class — noise-free, nugget, or heteroskedastic-noise kriging.
- [WarpKriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/WarpKriging.html): per-variable input warping for mixed/categorical/ordinal inputs.
- [MLPKriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/MLPKriging.html): joint MLP feature map (deep kernel learning).
- [NestedKriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/NestedKriging.html): divide-and-conquer kriging for large designs.
- [fit.Kriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/fit.Kriging.html), [predict.Kriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/predict.Kriging.html), [simulate.Kriging](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/functions/simulate.Kriging.html): fitting objectives (`LL`/`LOO`/`LMP`/`VLL(m)`), prediction, and conditional simulation.

## Mathematical background

- [Kriging models](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/KrigingModels.html) and [Kriging steps](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/KrigingSteps.html): the ordinary/universal kriging equations libKriging implements.
- [Kernel functions](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/kernel.html): `gauss`, `exp`, `matern3_2`, `matern5_2`.
- [Trend / regression models](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/trend.html): constant, linear, interactive, quadratic.
- [Likelihood](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/likelihood.html) and [leave-one-out](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/math/leaveOneOut.html): the `LL`/`LOO`/`LMP` fit objectives.

## Warping strategies

- [Warping overview](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/index.html): the spec-string vocabulary used by `WarpKriging`.
- [affine](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/affine.html), [boxcox](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/boxcox.html), [kumaraswamy](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/kumaraswamy.html): continuous-variable warps.
- [neural_mono](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/neural_mono.html), [mlp](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/mlp.html): learned monotone / joint feature-map warps.
- [categorical](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/categorical.html), [ordinal](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/warping/ordinal.html): discrete-variable embeddings.

## Noise strategies

- [Noise overview](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/noise/index.html): how to choose between noise-free, nugget, and heteroskedastic fits.
- [Noise-free](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/noise/noise-free.html), [nugget](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/noise/nugget.html), [heteroskedastic](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/noise/heteroskedastic.html).

## Optional

- [References / bibliography](https://libkriging.readthedocs.io/en/latest/references.html)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/libKriging/libKriging): source, issues, CHANGELOG, `AGENTS.md` build/API guidance for coding agents.
